fields.name: gatedEvent
fields.description: The event that triggered the approval request.

fields.name: subjectLabel
fields.description: Human title of the thing being approved (the article's headline, the page's title) — what the reviewer sees in the queue.
fields.synonyms: title, subject, what is being approved

fields.name: subjectId
fields.description: Id of the record being approved, for a queue row's View click-through to the subject's own surface.
fields.synonyms: record id, target id, article id, page id

fields.name: requestedByName
fields.description: Display name of the submitter shown in the queue.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current state of the approval process.

fields.name: reviewer
fields.description: The user or system responsible for reviewing the request.

fields.name: requestedAt
fields.description: Timestamp indicating when the approval request was initiated.
fields.synonyms: creation time, request date, submission time

fields.name: decidedAt
fields.description: Timestamp indicating when a decision was made on the request.
fields.synonyms: decision time, resolved at, completed at

fields.name: escalatedAt
fields.description: Timestamp indicating when the request was escalated.
fields.synonyms: escalation time, escalation timestamp, escalated time

fields.name: notes
fields.description: The reviewer's written reason, captured by the deny step.

fields.name: payload
fields.description: The held data of the gated action, replayed by the downstream listener when the request is granted.
fields.synonyms: request data, held payload, pending data, gated data

overridableConfigKeys.default: Tell the submitter why — the reason is recorded on the request.

events.name: APPROVE
events.description: Signals that an approval request has been approved.

events.name: DENY
events.description: Opens the deny step for a request; the decision commits with the written reason.

events.name: OPEN_SUBJECT
events.description: A reviewer clicked View on a queue row. Hosts route subjectId to the subject record's own surface so the reviewer can read what they are approving. Scalars only — the row stays in the queue.
events.synonyms: view subject, open record, inspect request, see the article

events.name: CONFIRM_DENY
events.description: The deny form committed; data carries the request id + the written reason.

events.name: CANCEL_DENY
events.description: The deny form was dismissed without committing; the queue repaints.

events.name: ApprovalGranted
events.description: Signals that an approval process has been successfully completed; carries the held payload for the downstream listener to replay. Contract: if the replay fails (access denial, write failure), the host MUST emit APPROVAL_REPLAY_FAILED back so the request reopens.

events.name: ApprovalDenied
events.description: Indicates an approval request has been denied, with the reviewer's written reason.

events.name: ApprovalRequestLoaded
events.description: Indicates an approval request has been successfully loaded.

events.name: ApprovalRequestLoadFailed
events.description: Indicates failure to load an approval request.
events.synonyms: load error, failed load, request failure

events.name: ApprovalRequestReviewed
events.description: Signals that an approval request has been reviewed.

events.name: ApprovalRequestReviewFailed
events.description: Indicates a failure to load or process an approval request for review.
events.synonyms: load error, failed review, processing failure

events.name: APPROVAL_REPLAY_FAILED
events.description: The host could not apply the granted action (access denial, failed write). The request reopens as pending so a decision is never silently lost.
events.synonyms: replay failed, apply failed, approval rollback

events.name: OPEN
events.description: Summons the review queue (host nav/affordance requests it).
events.synonyms: open, show, review, view queue, open approvals

overridableConfigKeys.label: Who can approve requests?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Roles eligible to decide. ENFORCED by the APPROVE/DENY transition guards: a viewer whose @user.role is not listed cannot fire a decision, from the button or from the bus. Empty = every signed-in viewer may decide (ungated).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: approver, reviewer, authorized roles, sign-off roles, who approves

overridableConfigKeys.label: Skip review queue for low-value requests?
overridableConfigKeys.description: When true, auto-approves requests below the threshold without queuing. v1.0 declarative only.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: auto approve, skip review, bypass queue, automatic approval

overridableConfigKeys.label: Block approving your own requests?
overridableConfigKeys.description: When on, a reviewer cannot APPROVE a request they submitted themselves (requestedBy = the viewer's id) — enforced by the APPROVE transition guard, from the button or from the bus. Requires hosts to stamp requestedBy at request creation. DENY stays allowed on your own request (denying your own request withdraws it). Off by default.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: self approval, self-approval, four eyes, four-eyes, separation of duties, cannot approve own, no self sign-off, dual control

overridableConfigKeys.label: Require approval
overridableConfigKeys.description: Require sign-off before a record is finalized. Off by default.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: enable, turn on, enforce, require, activate, apply, switch on, approval, needs approval, sign-off, signed off, review before, gatekeeper, editor approval, publishing approval, draft approval, content review, requires approval, manager approval, supervisor approval, admin approval, before going live

overridableConfigKeys.label: Escalate after how many hours pending?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Hours a request can sit pending before escalating. v1.0 declarative only.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: escalation time, SLA hours, pending timeout, escalate after

overridableConfigKeys.label: Who gets notified when a request escalates?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Roles notified on escalation (compose sibling std-notify-on-event to deliver).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: escalation contacts, escalate to, notify roles, escalated approver

overridableConfigKeys.label: Review slot
overridableConfigKeys.description: UI slot the review queue renders into. Defaults to the modal overlay so the queue never seizes the host's main content; summoned via OPEN, cleared via CLOSE.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Review queue table style
overridableConfigKeys.description: Visual treatment for the approval-queue data table.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: table style, grid look, compact, spacious, striped

overridableConfigKeys.label: Auto-approve below this value
overridableConfigKeys.description: Requests whose gated value is below this threshold are auto-approved. v1.0 declarative only.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: auto approve amount, skip review under, threshold, limit

overridableConfigKeys.label: Value field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Payload field name to compare against threshold (e.g. 'amount' on a RefundRequested event). v1.0 declarative only.
